params.name: startTime
params.description: A start time in RFC 3339 format. Defaults to now if not provided. Millisecond precision and timezones are supported. (Examples: 2019-06-13T19:08:25Z, 2019-06-13T19:08:25.455Z, OR 2015-09-15T14:00:12-04:00).
